_note: Model candidates for planning task execution by complexity. Preserve approved task assignments. Seeded on init and never overwritten on update. Verify provider/account availability and CLI capabilities before approval; model documentation is not proof of account access.

light._use: mechanical, low-ambiguity work; the answer is obvious and the diff is small

by_commit_type._note: Legacy fallback hint only. Approved task complexity/assignment takes precedence.

escalate_on_surface._note: If the task's fence touches any of these, override the type-derived tier upward. Match against file paths and the task title.

validation.degrade: Use approved independent review assignments; do not switch providers or tiers silently.
validation.acceptance: Required checks and task acceptance criteria pass; no blocking findings. Scores are diagnostic only.

defaults._note: Preserve effective permissions and user configuration; enable only approved capabilities where selective configuration is supported.
